summary: If compliance forbids `NOPASSWD` sudo, give the installer the sudo password with `./setup.sh <setup options> --ask-become-pass` (RPM) or `ansible-playbook ansible.containerized_installer.install --ask-become-pass` (containerized); the same applies for backup and restore.
questions: How do I run the AAP installer without NOPASSWD sudo?
AAP setup.sh prompt for sudo password
Backup fails because sudo needs a password

answer_card.title: Installer with a sudo password
answer_card.answer_md:
RPM:
```bash
./setup.sh <setup options> --ask-become-pass
```
Containerized:
```bash
ansible-playbook ansible.containerized_installer.install --ask-become-pass
```
Use the same flag for day-two runs such as backup and restore.
